faqs.a: Divide the annual salary by 52 weeks, then divide by the number of hours worked per week. For a standard 38-hour week, $101,700 per year becomes $101,700 ÷ 52 ÷ 38 ≈ $51.50 per hour. If you work more or fewer hours, adjust the divisor accordingly. Remember that this is a market estimate; your actual hourly rate may be set by an award or agreement.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the national minimum wage and an operations manager salary Sydney?

Always check the relevant award or the Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides for your classification.

faqs.q: How is superannuation calculated on an operations manager salary Sydney?

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Operations Manager Salary Sydney Landscape

When researching an **operations manager salary Sydney**, it helps to start with the official benchmarks set by the Fair Work Commission and the Fair Work Ombudsman, then compare them with market surveys. The national minimum wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour or $1,004.90 per week for 38 ordinary hours. Most operations managers earn well above this, but the minimum wage provides a floor for award-free employees.

Market data from PayScale suggests the average operations manager salary Sydney is about $101,700 per year, with a range from $70,000 to $158,000. However, these figures come from self-reported surveys and may not reflect your specific award or enterprise agreement. For authoritative pay rates, always check the [pay guides](/blog) from the Fair Work Ombudsman, which are updated with the latest award increases.

### Converting a Salary to an Hourly Rate

The standard formula used on this site is:

**Annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

For a 38‑hour week, the calculation becomes:

- $101,700 ÷ 52 ÷ 38 ≈ $51.50 per hour

If your role is advertised as a salary, you can reverse the calculation to find the hourly equivalent. The same formula works for any weekly hours – just replace 38 with your actual ordinary hours. For example, a 40‑hour week would give $101,700 ÷ 52 ÷ 40 ≈ $48.89 per hour.

### Fortnightly and Weekly Figures

Once you have the weekly amount, the fortnight is simply weekly × 2. For the $101,700 example:

- Weekly: $101,700 ÷ 52 ≈ $1,955.77
- Fortnightly: $1,955.77 × 2 ≈ $3,911.54

These figures are before tax and super. Use our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool to experiment with different hours.

## Award Rates vs Market Rates

Many operations managers are covered by awards such as the *Manufacturing and Associated Industries and Occupations Award 2020* or the *Clerks – Private Sector Award 2020*. Award rates are minimums; your actual pay may be higher due to enterprise agreements or individual contracts. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s pay guides show the minimum hourly rates for each classification level. For example, a Level 4 or 5 classification in the Clerks Award may be around $28–$32 per hour, which is still below the typical market rate for an operations manager.

If you are award‑free, the national minimum wage applies, plus a 25% casual loading if you are a casual employee. Casual loading is paid on top of the base rate, so a casual minimum wage worker would receive $33.05 per hour. Never enter a rate that already includes casual loading into the calculator – use the base rate and tick the casual loading checkbox.

### The Role of the Australian Bureau of Statistics

The ABS Average Weekly Earnings report (May 2026) shows full‑time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week. That equates to about $54.83 per hour for a 38‑hour week. This figure is a useful benchmark for professional roles, including operations managers. The all‑employees average (including part‑time) is $1,579.20 per week. These ABS figures are more reliable than recruiter surveys because they are based on payroll data.

## Tax and Superannuation on Your Operations Manager Salary Sydney

### Income Tax (2026–27 Resident Rates)

- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on the next $26,800 (up to $45,000)
- 30% on the next $90,000 (up to $135,000)
- 37% on the next $55,000 (up to $190,000)
- 45% above $190,000

Plus a Medicare levy of 2% (with possible reductions for low incomes). For a $101,700 salary, the estimated tax (including Medicare) would be roughly $24,000–$25,000, depending on your exact circumstances. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) guide for a detailed breakdown.

### Superannuation Guarantee

From 1 July 2026, employers must pay 12% super on ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. Super is paid on top of your salary, not deducted from it. For a $101,700 salary, the annual super contribution would be $12,204. If your salary exceeds the maximum base, super is capped at $270,830 × 12% = $32,499.60.

## Using the Timesheet for Your Own Calculations

Our [the timesheet](/) allows you to enter your base hourly rate and optionally add 25% casual loading. The calculator then shows your weekly, fortnightly, monthly and annual gross pay, plus estimated tax and super. Remember:

- The calculator assumes 38 ordinary hours per week unless you change it.
- It uses the same rate every week – no unpaid overtime, penalty rates or allowances.
- Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base.
- Tax uses the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax‑free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed here.
- HELP, Medicare levy surcharge and salary packaging are not deducted.

This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax. For personalised advice, consult a registered tax agent.

## Final Thoughts on Operations Manager Salary Sydney

Whether you are negotiating a new role or checking your current pay, understanding the conversion between annual salary and hourly rate is essential. The typical operations manager salary Sydney sits well above the national minimum wage, but award rates and enterprise agreements may set a different floor. Always verify your classification using the [reference tables](/data) and the Fair Work Ombudsman’s pay guides. And remember that super is paid on top of your salary, so factor that into your total remuneration package.
